correctness.rationale: For |δ|<1/3 nonzero, uniform X1 and iid increments Y_t in Z/3 with P(0)=1/3, P(+1)=1/3+δ, P(−1)=1/3−δ define a strictly positive stationary ergodic chain. Under IID uniform X_t, the change of variables to X1 and all increments is a bijection preserving their iid uniform distribution. Thus nonzero-step indicators are iid Bernoulli(2/3) under both laws and R_n=1+Bin(n−1,2/3) exactly. The conditional-count plug-in runs center is 2n/3+O_P(1) and variance 2n/9+o_P(n); CLT/Slutsky give asymptotic N(0,1). The transition operator on the zero-sum subspace has eigenvalues ±i√3 δ; even-lag covariance summation yields factor cδ=(1−3δ²)/(1+3δ²)<1; the finite-state CLT gives H_n⇒cδ χ²_2. The Bonferroni union bound therefore gives limsup rejection ≤α/2+(α/2)^(1/cδ)<α. A signed transition statistic has mean 2δ per increment and is consistent. Independent rational enumeration for n=2..6 reproduced exact run laws, directional moments and Pearson expectations. No exact limiting union probability is asserted.
